text_block_list.text:
After our outing, I walked Special Week back
to the front of the dorms, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today!
Our outing was super fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
I don't want to go home just yet today."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm fully refreshed,
I feel like I can suuuuper concentrate on training!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So, how about coming along with me
for a bit from here on...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well then, what shall we do?
I can handle anything, so don't hesitate to ask!
choice_data_list: Let's nail the trick to a strong finishing kick
Let's get the hang of cornering.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see, this is the kind of training
you want to thoroughly do while you have full concentration!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Time to give it my all!

Thanks to the refreshing outing, she was more focused than usual,
and Special Week got the hang of her finishing burst!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see, it's harder than expected, isn't it?
It might be best to do it while you still have your concentration!
